```{r}
# Home-page Pass / Caution / Fail rules: gain within 2 / 3 SD of a 1-month
# trailing band, and %rCV pass/fail at 6%, over every detector. See
# pages/_home_status.R.
source("pages/_home_status.R")

ArchiveHasRows <- function(inst) {
  f <- list.files(file.path(MainFolder, inst, "Archive"), pattern = "Archived",
                  full.names = TRUE)
  length(f) == 1 && nrow(read.csv(f[1], nrows = 1)) > 0
}
Instruments <- Filter(ArchiveHasRows, c("3L", "5L", "EVO"))

Scores    <- setNames(lapply(Instruments, home_qc_scores, MainFolder = MainFolder),
                      Instruments)
RunStatus <- lapply(Scores, home_run_status)
Tables    <- lapply(Scores, function(s) home_small_table(home_latest_table(s)))
Triggers  <- dplyr::bind_rows(Map(home_triggers, Scores, names(Scores))) |>
  dplyr::filter(Date > Sys.Date() - months(24))
TriggerTable <- home_trigger_table(Triggers)

Data <- home_history(RunStatus)
AltData <- Data |> dplyr::filter(Date > Sys.Date() - months(24))
GlobalSummary <- Luciernaga:::SmallTableGlobal(AltData)

TheDate <- Data |> slice(1) |> pull(Date)

InstStatus <- function(inst) {
  if (!inst %in% Instruments)
    return(list(text = "Awaiting data", color = "secondary"))
  s <- RunStatus[[inst]]$QCStatus[1]
  list(text  = dplyr::coalesce(Luciernaga:::InstrumentText(s), "Unscored"),
       color = dplyr::coalesce(Luciernaga:::InstrumentColor(s), "secondary"))
}
S3L <- InstStatus("3L"); S5L <- InstStatus("5L"); SEVO <- InstStatus("EVO")
TableOr <- function(inst)
  if (inst %in% Instruments) Tables[[inst]] else htmltools::HTML("<em>Awaiting first QC data</em>")
```

# Status

## {.sidebar}
Dashboard data last updated on **`r TheDate`**

**Definitions:**

Status is scored on every detector for the most recent daily QC run. Each detector's gain is compared with the mean ± SD of its own runs over the previous month.

**Pass:** All gains within 2 SD of the 1-month trailing band and all %rCVs at or below 6%.

**Caution:** All gains within 3 SD of the 1-month trailing band, but at least one more than 2 SD out, and all %rCVs at or below 6%. The instrument remains usable, but resolution for fluorophores on the flagged detector may decrease.

**Fail:** Any gain more than 3 SD from the 1-month trailing band, or any %rCV above 6%. Significant variation and batch effects may occur.

The **Triggers** page lists every Caution or Fail run with the detectors that caused it. *Gain shift* counts how many flagged detectors moved up vs down: a shift across many detectors in the same direction may be bead degradation rather than the instrument, so cross-check it against the 6-peak MFI data.

For additional information, navigate to the [Help](pages/help.qmd) page.

**About**

This dashboard contains the visualized QC data for the Cytek cytometers at the Sydney Cytometry Core Facility

For additional flow cytometry resources, visit our [website](https://sydneycytometry.org.au/)

This dashboard was created with [Quarto](https://quarto.org/), based on work by [David Rach](https://github.com/DavidRach).
